❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How is radius found from volume?
From V = (4/3)πr³, so r = ∛(3V / 4π).
Volume vs surface area?
Volume is the space inside ((4/3)πr³); surface area is the skin of the sphere (4πr²).
What units are the answers in?
Whatever length unit you use: volume comes out in cubic units, area in square units.
